text:
leah: Quick heads-up: scheduling a staggered NIC firmware flush + soft reboot in az29 this Thu 02:00 UTC for nebula-gpu-pool. Goal = minimal disruption, rolling cohorts with KV priming after each. Target hosted floor = 55%.

carlos: how many cohorts and expected total window?

leah: plan = canary (1 node) + 4 cohorts of 6 nodes each. Each cohort ~35-45m including warmback and verification. Total ~3.5h safe window to include fallbacks.

jon: can we exclude pinned/dedicated customer pools? we should not touch reserved nodes.

leah: yes 10 reserved/pinned pools are excluded by default via label `inference.reserved=true`.

maya: i'll run the canary smoke and perf checks. what are the acceptance gates?

leah: smoke gates: health OK, no >12% increase in p99 for 3 consecutive minutes, no error-rate spike >0.5% (token-level errors). Canary routing: 1% traffic. Perf snippet to run:
```bash
# canary perf (3 runs, 64 tokens)
python infra/tools/infer_bench.py --model open-llama-13b --tag canary --tokens 64 --runs 3
curl -s https://nebula-az29/health | jq .status
```

ops-bot: Maintenance ticket created MAINT-az29-2026-03-05. PagerDuty oncall notified.

carlos: cost implications if we backfill with burst instances?

leah: estimate warm spares used for priming; worst-case additional GPU-hours ~4.5h. Ballpark incremental cost ~$180. I'll add cost line to the ticket and flag finance.

jon: rollback plan if NIC firmware causes throughput regression?

leah: rollback TL;DR in ticket + short commands below. full steps in MAINT ticket.
```bash
# rollback (short)
# 1) stop drain and uncordon affected nodes
kubectl uncordon <node> -n inference --context=az29
# 2) revert fw via ansible
ansible-playbook -i inventory/az29 revert-nic-fw.yml --limit=@cohort.txt
# 3) swap routing back
/ops/bin/route_swap --from=canary --to=stable
```

maya: will abort if p99 >12% or error-rate >0.5% during canary. i'll post results within 15m of canary completion.

leah: monitoring: we'll enable high-res metrics (15s) for the window and keep 1h post-cohort at 1m resolution. set slack alerts for p99 and error spikes.

ops-bot: PagerDuty policy MAINT-az29-critical attached. Oncall: @jon.

jon: i'll be oncall for the run. plan to watch token-level tail + host sched/interrupts dash. set ephemeral alerts for NIC drops.

carlos: please include opt-out list for customers that requested maintenance blackout.

leah: opt-out respected; ticket excludes customers listed in `MAINT-az29/exclude.csv`. Also adding a note to #support to surface customer comms.

leah: quick runbook timeline (short):
T-60m: announce in #eng-infra and #support
T-20m: cordon canary node(s)
T-15m: perform canary fw flush + soft reboot
T-10m: enable 1% canary routing, run smoke perf
T-5m: evaluate gates -> if OK start cohort 1 drain
T+40m per cohort: uncordon backfilled nodes, KV cache priming script (/ops/scripts/kv_warmup.sh)

maya: noted. i'll paste smoke outputs here. if any gate tripped -> full rollback and halt.

leah: final: I'll post start timestamp + ticket link 30m before the window. :thumbsup:
